claims.text: The use of AI tools in courses and transparency requirements are determined by the teacher-assigned AI index level.

evidence.quote: The use of AI tools in your study, and the extent to which this is allowed, and to which you must be transparent about its deployment, is determined by the AI index. Ask your teacher/supervisor if anything is not clear.

topics.summary: 保留的指引指出，输入部分生成式AI工具的数据可能被模型开发者用于训练和改进模型。
topics.scope: 全校科研人员指引与GDPR规范

claims.text: The retained guidance says data entered into some generative AI tools may be used by model developers to train and improve models.

evidence.quote: Using GenAI involves processing large amounts of data, which can in many cases contain personal data. Depending on the AI tool you use, the data with which you prompt the model could eventually be used by the model developers to train and improve the models on which the tool is based.
evidence.title: Risks and limitations of GenAI in research

claims.text: Data flow evaluations are conducted for centrally deployed services; universal AI Veritas certification for all tools remains an unverified gap.

evidence.quote:
Before an AI tool can be used within UU education, an allowlisting process must take place.

What is allowlisting?

As a university, we place great importance to scientific integrity and information security. Before we can allow the use of an AI tool within the university, we therefore want to know exactly what happens to the data entered into the tool. This allows us to guarantee the security of your data and that of the university. We call this process allow listing.
evidence.title: Allow listing process
